neighbours.label: the word right before a named person in news, a title or an opponent cue ('Prime Minister', 'against', 'rookie') that predicts a name
fire: In the second round, the defending champion lost unexpectedly against Casper Ruud in four sets.
Speaking in parliament on Tuesday, Prime Minister Mark Carney defended the new budget.
The veteran goalkeeper made three saves against rookie striker Leo Brandt in the final minutes.
Foreign Minister Penny Wong arrived in Jakarta for two days of talks.
She will face off against Iga Swiatek in the semifinal on Friday afternoon.
The decision was announced by Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil after a cabinet meeting.
Djokovic struggled early against Alexander Zverev before taking the second set.
Deputy Prime Minister Chrystia Freeland said the tariffs would be reviewed.
quiet: In the second round, the defending champion lost unexpectedly in four long sets on clay.
Speaking in parliament on Tuesday, the government defended the new budget plan.
The veteran goalkeeper made three saves in the final minutes to keep the lead.
The foreign ministry sent a delegation to Jakarta for two days of talks.
She will play in the semifinal on Friday afternoon if the rain holds off.

Djokovic struggled early in the windy conditions before taking the second set.

notes: Card: peaks on ' Minister' (Deputy/Prime Minister + name), ' against' + tennis opponent, ' rookie' + name, Russian 'премьер-министр' + name. Shared pattern: the token after which a person's name is expected. Near misses keep the topic but the slot is followed by a non-name.
